title: Confidential deployments carry a dual cap on both monthly reward flow and outstanding unaccepted stock
content:
A.6.1.1.1.3.10.4 acknowledges that yield accrued on confidentially deployed Spark Savings vaults "may constitute obligations incurred pursuant to this framework," then bounds those obligations twice over. On-chain parameters and off-chain configuration must be set such that "the total aggregate rewards that may accrue **per month** will not exceed USD 5 million in value, **and** the total aggregate rewards **outstanding** for all Confidential Strategic Integration and Deployment vaults still awaiting Governance Acceptance shall not exceed USD 5 million in value."

One cap constrains a rate, the other a stock, and either alone would leak.

A monthly flow cap alone permits unbounded accumulation: $5 million a month for eighteen months while confidentiality holds is $90 million of liability governance never voted on. A stock cap alone permits an instantaneous commitment — the entire $5 million could be promised in a week, exhausting the framework's capacity before anyone reviewed anything.

Together they bound the worst case in both dimensions, and the stock cap does something the flow cap cannot: it is scoped to vaults **still awaiting Governance Acceptance**, so it *drains as deals are ratified*. Accepting a deployment moves its obligations out of the confidential bucket and frees headroom for the next one. The framework's capacity is therefore self-regulating — the Foundation cannot start a fifth confidential integration without getting earlier ones approved, which is a direct structural incentive to bring deals into the open promptly.

This is also the framework's most concrete concession to the transparency problem. Whatever governance does not know about, it knows the size of: the maximum unacknowledged liability sitting in confidential deployments at any moment is a published number.
description: Aggregate rewards accruing per month and total rewards outstanding across all vaults still awaiting Governance Acceptance are each limited to USD 5 million in value.
